A karyotype tells us which chromosomes a cell has, how many copies there are, and whether their structure has changed.
核型告诉我们细胞有哪些染色体、各有几份，以及它们的结构是否改变。
That can help diagnose genetic disorders and some cancers.
这能为遗传病和某些癌症的诊断提供线索。
When a living cell divides, can we see where an abnormal chromosome count comes from?
活细胞分裂时，我们能看出异常的染色体数目是怎么产生的吗？
We lack a general way to label chromosome identities through mitosis.
我们仍缺少能在有丝分裂中标记染色体身份的通用方法。
ChromoWorld brings two streams together. Fixed cells provide the reference identities.
ChromoWorld 汇合两路数据。固定细胞提供参考身份。
ChromoPix identifies them, and ChromoLift builds a three-dimensional reference atlas.
ChromoPix 识别这些染色体，ChromoLift 建立带身份的三维参考图谱。
ChromoPose separates live instances. Tracking links them. ChromoID matches their shapes.
ChromoPose 分割活细胞实例，追踪把它们串起来，ChromoID 匹配它们的形态。
G-banding shows stripes on dehydrated chromosomes. In rehydrated FISH images, the stripes disappear and shapes become more varied.
G 显带下，脱水染色体有清晰的条纹。复水后的 FISH 图像没有这些条纹，染色体的形态也更多样。
All three models train on G-banding alone. Each loses accuracy when tested on FISH.
三种模型都只用 G 显带训练。在 FISH 上测试时，准确性都下降了。
In this FISH field, Mask R-CNN finds no instances. Both YOLO models draw masks, but assign incorrect chromosome identities.
在同一个 FISH 视野里，Mask R-CNN 没有检出实例。两个 YOLO 模型画出了掩膜，但给出了错误的染色体身份。
FISH brings us closer. Rehydrated chromosomes lack bands, but DNA probes can identify them.
FISH 让我们接近活细胞形态。复水染色体没有条纹，但 DNA 探针依然能提供身份。
Probe labels are precise, but sparse within a field.
探针能给出精确身份，但在单个视野中，这类标签往往是稀疏的。
ChromoPix learns from the labels and from paired views of the same chromosome. One view keeps the shape while suppressing fine texture.
ChromoPix 既从标签中学习，也让同一条染色体形成成对视图。其中一个视图保留形态、弱化纹理。
Aligning their features rewards what survives that change. A chromosome-class prompt lets the decoder focus on one identity at a time.
对齐两种视图的特征，可以保留改变后仍存在的信息。类别提示让解码器一次聚焦一种身份。
We measure one tagged chromosome, then use UMAP to place its shape at a point.
我们测量一条有荧光标注的染色体，再用 UMAP 把它的形态落成一个点。
Pull back to more than seven hundred thousand chromosome instances. Each point has a shape, and its color marks a chromosome class.
拉远到七十多万个染色体实例。每个点对应一条染色体的形态，颜色代表类别。
Across both preparations, the classes follow a similar order. Can those relationships carry over to living cells?
两种制样中，染色体类别的排列顺序相似。这些形态关系能迁移到活细胞吗？
Whole-cell projections can collapse identities. Better views recover only part of the order.
整细胞投影可能让不同染色体被判为同类。优化投影也只能恢复部分秩序。
First, separate the chromosomes in three dimensions.
第一步是在三维中把染色体分别分割出来。
Here FAST-CHIMP produces many small fragments. Cellpose-SAM shows broader, joined-looking regions.
在同一帧中，FAST-CHIMP 切出了许多小碎片，Cellpose-SAM 有一些看起来粘连的宽块。
ChromoPose better preserves long, separate shapes in this frame.
在这一帧中，ChromoPose 更好地保留了细长、彼此分开的形态。
To follow a bend, ChromoPose first uses predicted distance and flow to move voxels toward the local centerline.
为了顺着弯曲的形态，ChromoPose 先用预测的距离和流向，让体素靠近局部中心线。
Then it follows the learned flow along the bend. Voxels that converge together form one instance.
随后沿弯曲的结构积分流场，把汇聚到同一位置的体素归为一个实例。
Tracking links those three-dimensional instances across frames. Their measured shapes become the input for chromosome identification.
追踪把各帧的三维实例连接起来，实测形态再用于推断染色体身份。
A live chromosome provides its own training pair: its projection and its measured three-dimensional shape, including volume, elongation, and sphericity.
每条活细胞染色体都能提供自己的训练对：它的投影，以及体积、伸长程度和球形度等三维实测形态。
ChromoLift learns that mapping with flow matching. It moves compact shape descriptors, so thousands of labeled references can be lifted in batches.
ChromoLift 用流匹配学习这种映射。它处理的是紧凑的形态描述符，因此可以成批提升有标签的参考实例。
The same shapes, three results. Direct projection mixes identities. Optimal projection helps. ChromoPhy restores a clearer order.
同样的形态，三种结果。直接投影让身份混杂，最优投影有所改善，ChromoPhy 恢复了更清晰的类别秩序。
ChromoID ranks identities by matching physical measurements, including volume and shape, to that atlas.
ChromoID 把体积和形态等物理测量值与参考图谱匹配，对候选身份排序。
We can compare the reviewed chromosome three candidates with the measured fluorescence.
这里可以把人工复核过的 3 号染色体候选与实测荧光对照。
For chromosome eighteen, the tag also lets us check where the candidates sit over time.
18 号染色体的荧光标记同样可以用来核对候选实例随时间变化的位置。
In patient-derived tumor cells, imaging suggested that one daughter received two copies of chromosome fourteen and the other received four.
在患者来源的肿瘤细胞中，成像提示两个子细胞分别获得了两份和四份 14 号染色体。
We isolated daughter cells and grew them into separate clones.
我们分离子细胞，再分别培养成克隆。
Copy-number differences persisted across passages.
拷贝数差异在连续传代中得到保留。
Higher-copy clones showed stronger AKT signaling and greater sensitivity to capivasertib in the lab.
高拷贝克隆的 AKT 信号更强，在体外也对 capivasertib 更敏感。
Higher-copy clones showed stronger A K T signaling and greater sensitivity to capivasertib in the lab.
The clinical team independently chose capivasertib with endocrine therapy.
临床团队独立选择了 capivasertib 联合内分泌治疗。
Liver target lesions shrank by nearly a third at eight weeks, and by nearly half at eighteen.
第 8 周，肝脏靶病灶直径总和下降近三分之一，第 18 周下降近一半。
Tumor markers and liver biochemistry improved. Daily function improved too, with less liver pain and fatigue.
肿瘤标志物和肝脏生化指标改善。患者日常活动能力提高，肝区疼痛和疲劳减轻。
Reading chromosome identities in living cells lets us ask what an unequal division sets in motion.
读出活细胞中的染色体身份，才有机会追问一次不均等分裂会带来什么。
